name: initialise_record_and_pointer_table

name: build_pointer_table_from_offsets

name: lookup_then_invoke_callback

name: wrap_call_with_flag_toggle

name: zero_global_block_and_call

name: service_audio_tick_counter

name: silence_audio_and_reset_state
description: Sets the volumes of the four audio channels to zero and disables their DMA and interrupts. It then copies a 12-byte record chosen by an index into the global block, clears 776 bytes of globals, loads the counters from stored values and calls another routine.

name: open_ciab_resource_and_call
description: Opens the ciab.resource through an exec library call and, if a handle comes back, fills a small structure and calls a second library entry on it. It returns one when that second call returns zero and zero otherwise.

name: install_musicirq_interrupt_handler
description: Fills a small interrupt structure that references the musicirq name and passes it to a library call at a fixed offset. It then writes two CIA-B control values and returns whether the call result was zero.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value one and does nothing else. It is called by two unnamed routines.

name: return_doubled_global_byte
description: Returns a 16-bit value made by repeating one global byte in both halves. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: compute_and_write_timer_count
description: Computes a timer count by dividing a fixed constant by a global divisor, falling back to a fixed default when the divisor is zero. It writes the count's two bytes and a control value to the timer registers, then calls another routine and stores its result.

name: silence_audio_and_clear_block
description: Clears 776 bytes of global memory, sets a global control byte to fifteen and zeroes the volume of audio channel zero. It returns its input value unchanged.

name: store_pair_and_set_flag
description: Copies one stored word into another global slot, stores the incoming value into a third slot and sets a global flag word to one.

name: reset_flag_and_clear_block
description: Clears a global flag word, zeroes 776 bytes of global memory, then calls one unnamed routine and returns.

name: service_tick_slots_with_dma
description: Advances a tick counter and, when it reaches its limit, resets it and runs a further step. It clears per-channel slot bytes through unnamed routines when a flag is set and moves a pending value into the first slot when one is set. The audio location and DMA registers are referenced in the facts.

name: select_channel_data_pointer
description: Reads the parameter record for the current channel. When its length field is one it stores the address of another routine with a length of one, and otherwise it computes a pointer into a global table from two fields and stores it with the length.

name: service_four_audio_channels
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then calls another routine for each of four audio channel pointers that is non-zero. It returns the result of the last call when the fourth pointer is set, and sets a global status word to its top bit only.

name: advance_sequence_step
description: Advances a step counter and, when it reaches its limit, resets the counter, moves the sequence index forward with a loop point and loads four longword values for the next step from a table.

name: load_channel_values_from_table
description: For each of four enabled channels, loads a longword from a table at the channel's stored index plus the current step and stores it in that channel's output slot.

name: invoke_single_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code, so the evidence is limited to its twelve instructions and one call to an unnamed routine. Its purpose cannot be determined from these facts.

name: call_unrecovered_jump_target

name: store_word_into_record_field
description: Stores its incoming 16-bit value into a fixed offset within a record addressed by a register and returns nothing else.

name: decode_channel_command_byte
description: Decodes a command byte for one audio channel. The special values zero, 127 and 128 take separate paths, while other values update the channel's step value, clear a 62-byte state block and call further routines.

name: bind_channel_table_entry
description: Looks up a table entry for the channel's index. When the entry is empty it calls another routine and clears a status byte; otherwise it stores the entry and an offset-adjusted value in the channel state and sets the status byte to all ones.

name: copy_channel_block_into_buffer
description: Copies a block of table data for the channel's index into a destination buffer in 16-byte groups. It records the destination and the length in the channel state, then clears a status byte.

name: load_channel_record_fields
description: Stores the channel's index, locates the matching fixed-size record in the table and copies its timing, scaling and volume fields into the channel state. One copied value is also shifted left by two.

name: copy_channel_timing_fields
description: Copies timing, scaling and volume fields from a table record into the channel state and clears the related counters. It also stores one value shifted left by two.

name: clear_channel_playback_state
description: Zeroes several position, length and index fields of a channel state block and clears a status byte.

name: call_four_channel_routines
description: Calls one unnamed routine four times in a row and returns. The facts show references to the four audio location registers, so the calls appear to serve the four channels.

name: update_channel_tick_state
description: Advances one audio channel by a tick: it applies table-driven offsets, interpolates the level toward a target, updates the playback counters and clamps the stored volume between zero and 64. It calls another routine when a sample table entry is set.

name: run_channel_effect_step
description: Counts down a per-channel timer and, when it expires, reloads it and applies one of several sample effects selected by an effect code. The effects seen in the code negate sample bytes, add a constant or table values to a block and rotate a block by one byte.

name: call_unrecovered_jump_target

name: negate_sample_byte_and_advance

name: decode_and_patch_game_startup

name: write_jump_patch_to_routine

name: save_eight_registers_to_block

name: store_low_byte_to_global

name: poll_until_sentinel_value

name: call_and_return_register

name: call_hook_when_flag_set

name: call_pointer_then_store_value

name: advance_timed_block_copy

name: extract_high_byte_pair

description: Writes all ones to a global port register, then repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and waits for a bit in a global to clear until the routine returns one. It returns zero.

name: update_table_entry
description: Reads a word from a table indexed by a frame field, and when that word is negative it returns the result of an unnamed call. Otherwise it calls an unnamed routine once per unit of difference between the stored and new values, then stores the new value in the table.

name: poll_flag_then_clear_entry
description: Polls a global flag for up to 86 iterations, calling an unnamed routine between checks. When the flag clears it zeroes a table entry indexed by a frame field and returns zero; if the flag never clears it returns a fixed error code.

name: drive_port_bits_and_wait
description: Sets the lowest bit of a global port register and clears the second bit when a register byte is not negative. It then repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and waits for a global bit to clear until the routine returns one, and returns zero.

name: store_routine_result_to_port
description: Calls one unnamed routine and writes its result to a global port register.

name: build_port_byte_from_table
description: Builds a port byte from a frame field and a bit index, clearing one further bit when a looked-up table entry has its lowest bit set. It returns the byte together with its data register argument.

name: start_ciab_timer_when_idle
description: When a global status bit is clear and the register argument is not one, writes three values to the CIA-B control register in sequence. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: set_ciab_timer
description: Writes three values to a global timer control register in sequence. The facts show the CIA-B timer control and count registers.

name: undecompiled_routine_with_calls
description: The decompiler timed out. The facts show it writes the background colour register, the copper pointer and the interrupt enable, references the text df0:JS and df0:intro and makes five unnamed calls. Its purpose cannot be determined from these facts.

name: increment_digit_until_done
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and, while it returns nonzero, advances a digit character in a structure, cycling from three back to zero. It returns the register argument unchanged.

name: unpack_signed_block_backwards
description: Checks that a block begins with a four-character signature and, if so, unpacks it from the end backwards, reading run and copy codes from unnamed routines. It then moves the result to the start of the block.

name: test_upper_bits_no_effect
description: Tests whether a register has any bits above its lowest bit and returns in both cases. The routine has no observable effect.

name: shift_bits_from_backward_stream
description: Shifts a bit buffer right one bit at a time. Whenever the buffer runs out it refills it from the packed data one longword at a time, moving backwards through memory.

name: shift_bits_from_backward_stream
description: Shifts a bit buffer right one bit at a time. Whenever the buffer runs out it refills it from the packed data one longword at a time, moving backwards through memory.

name: unpack_run_length_stream
description: Decodes a run-length packed stream: a positive control byte copies the following bytes literally, a negative control byte repeats the next byte, and the value 128 ends the stream.

name: step_palette_entries_toward_target
description: For sixteen palette entries, moves each 4-bit red, green and blue channel one step toward a target value and stores the result in the destination list. It makes two unnamed calls per entry and only updates colour words whose register address lies within a fixed range.

name: fade_palette_entries_toward_zero
description: For sixteen palette entries, reduces each non-zero 4-bit red, green and blue channel by one step and stores the result in the destination list. It makes two unnamed calls per entry.

name: wait_for_interrupt
description: Polls the interrupt request register until a particular bit is set, then writes that bit's value to a global variable and returns it.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Empty routine that returns to its caller without doing anything.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Empty routine that returns to its caller without doing anything.

name: undecompiled_routine_with_calls
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the facts are known: a thirteen-instruction program entry that references the text I_AM.PDC and makes one unnamed call. Its purpose cannot be determined from these facts.

name: undecompiled_routine_with_calls
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the facts are known: a four-instruction routine that calls a constant-returning routine and one unnamed routine. Its purpose cannot be determined from these facts.

name: undecompiled_dma_register_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the facts are known: a ten-instruction routine that touches the DMA control and interrupt enable registers and is called by one unnamed routine. Its purpose cannot be determined from these facts.

name: return_offset_pair_with_tag
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then returns the register pair with its low word increased by eight and a fixed value OR-ed into its upper bits.

name: parse_escape_control_codes
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte stream. An escape byte followed by the letter b stores the low nibble of the next byte into a frame field, and other bytes are passed to an unnamed routine unless they are the start-of-line code.

name: forward_single_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns. It is called by one unnamed routine.

name: write_masked_bitplane_rows
description: Walks a stream of bytes and writes masked values into four bitplane offsets spaced 4000 words apart. A flag in the frame selects whether each write merges the bits or clears them first.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Empty routine that returns to its caller without doing anything.

name: write_value_until_null_pointer
description: Calls two unnamed routines on each pass and writes the value thirteen to a pointer, repeating until the pointer is null. It first stores a register word into a global.

name: forward_single_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: scan_line_terminator_and_parse
description: Clears a frame field, then scans a string for a carriage return or vertical bar. When that character is followed by a terminator and the letter P, it stores the next character in a frame field, and it always writes a terminator at the position found.

name: iterate_rectangle_calling_routine
description: Walks a rectangular grid of positions described by a header block, calling one unnamed routine for each cell and stepping two coordinates per iteration. Odd and even widths are handled by separate loops.

name: repeat_call_five_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine five times in a row and returns.

name: store_word_around_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, stores a register word at one address register target, calls the routine again and stores the same word at a second target.

name: shift_bits_into_result_word
description: Builds a 16-bit result one bit at a time, turning each bit of the input into a flag in the result and combining the lowest input bit with an extend flag. It returns the assembled word.

name: repeat_call_five_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine five times in a row and returns.

name: store_byte_twice_around_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, stores the register byte at an address register target, calls the routine again, then stores the same byte at the next address.

name: assemble_six_bit_flags_word
description: Builds a result word from the low six bits of an input word, turning each bit into a flag and combining the lowest input bit with an extend flag. It returns the assembled word.

name: undecompiled_raw_code_region
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the facts are known: an eleven-instruction raw code region at the start of its file. Its calls and purpose cannot be determined from these facts.

name: conditional_chain_of_calls
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then makes further unnamed calls only while a condition flag stays set, and returns the register pair. The facts reference the text FORM, but the code does not show how it is used.

name: call_then_guarded_check
description: Calls one unnamed routine and tests its result against twenty, but a flag fixed at false guards that test, so the routine always returns without action.
